content:
Hey there and welcome aboard : )

The hectic train is designed to be a challenging gameplay.
In Morimens, awakener levels matter a whole lot. Although sticking to recommanded level is usually not strictly required, a lvl 40 team is indeed a bit low.

Poison and counter are ways to deal with dmg-down debuffs but that specific mechanic is actually not that common.
There is not, to my knowledge, an awakener that cleans any and all debufs from the team.

content:
i watched some of the replay, and for this boss specifically, you can't just unload your whole load onto the boss first turn because for the first 8 turns in phase 1, the boss won't die and cleanse ur buff and its debuffs every time it loses an hp bar. so you have to play smart and conservative, also if u need the extra shielding, u can thais exalt dupe pollux's defense card when you use oe on him, otherwise u wanna mostly dupe his 3 cost.. another thing to note is you really wanna put the breeding orison on pollux 3 cost cause that's where most of your dmg will come from, sacred heart 3/3 -> double play 3 cost, but since you don't have many copies of it, your burst is lacking. i also suggest using lone seed posse (to dupe more cleansing judgements) or his own posse. your objective first 8 turns is to survive and survive UNTIL he does massive hits that you don't wanna take too much damage of, in which case you can phase him to avoid that damage. 

also drop saya's R wheel and put on on the frenzy R wheel, you need more cursed relics to make your life easier and pollux SR wheel could be changed to like analysis of death (cat sr wheel) since it's scaling exploration OR blade of titan +12 if you have that, since thats one of the recommended standard wheels to rush +12 for early on. final thing is you can sort of cheese the boss with bleed right on turn 8 when the boss is doing his intention to transform into bigger eye, you can unleash ur whole burst turn there after saving up many 3/3 sacreds and cleansings because that bleed will transfer over to his big eye and it'll proc on next turn, chunking a lot of hp. 

for second phase on the big eye, you just have to play the gimmicks right and read the mechanic each turn so you don't mess up but its very doable, you can't be losing a DR that early on in the first phase though, hope this helps <:Helot_slack_off:1459092159465521184>

Good advice here, especially in regards to the cat WoD since crit. Damage will increase after fighting all the mobs in preparation for the boss. One final suggestion I’d say is throwing more death resistance covenants (burial grounds sigh) onto the three supports since your death resistance is pretty low

Thank you so much for taking the time to watch the replay and give this advice! Some of this things will take time because I still don't have a +12 blade of titan and to reply to the other person I still don't have a full burial set either (been farming events mostly), but I wasn't aware of some of these early mechanics for the boss and thought I could simply brute force with Pollux bleed. Come to think of it a lot of replays I've watched save their exalts / cards for later turns.
I tried to put the breeding orison on his 3 cost in previous runs but the problem I ran into came in the second part, where (probably bc of misplaying) the cards I needed kept disappearing 😅

Just one thing, I'm confused because in other runs, when I attacked the boss before the transformation, I had the impression the damage was wasted. Doesn't it recover its HP bar at some point? Or am I mistaking it for another boss?

Thanks again to both! This motivates me to try again 🙏 I'll post an update if I end up succeeding in not using ecogs
